chunks: “If forgetfulness becomes frequent for you during the salat (prayer), then continue with your prayer and do not repeat it.”

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام, the speaker of this hadith
key_terms.السَّهْوُ: forgetfulness or inattentiveness occurring in prayer
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual act of worship under discussion

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if forgetfulness becomes frequent during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام instructs that when frequent forgetfulness occurs in salat (prayer), one should proceed with the prayer and not repeat it. The hadith gives a practical legal ruling intended to prevent hardship and excessive repetition in worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "If you experience frequent distraction (waswasah) during your prayer, continue with your prayer and do not repeat it."
